title: CXO Interview with Vishal Moondhra of Perforce IPLM
gist: Perforce IPLM's Vishal Moondhra argues that siloed semiconductor IP depreciates and forces costly rebuilds—worse in an AI/agentic era—and predicts IP reuse as a formal workflow strategy will be the 2027 growth area; Perforce claims 11 of the top 15 semiconductor companies as customers and accelerated engagements with four of the largest in 2026.

themes.theme: Siloed IP as a hidden cost

insights.claim: Vishal Moondhra argues siloed semiconductor IP depreciates like any asset, and companies end up rebuilding the same blocks—wasting tokens or engineering time—because of a visibility gap, especially after expansions or acquisitions.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: IP-management tooling demand rises with M&A activity and AI-driven design churn.
insights.quote: Like any asset, siloed IP depreciates over time.
insights.locator: What is the biggest challenge your customers are facing?

insights.claim: In the AI era, fast-moving tools and processes make it easy for the context around an IP block to be lost, leaving it unseen by both human teams and AI agents.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Agentic EDA workflows raise the value of metadata and provenance layers.
insights.locator: What is the biggest challenge your customers are facing?

insights.claim: Perforce says 11 of the top 15 semiconductor companies work with it on IP and data management.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Indicates dominant installed base in semiconductor IP lifecycle management.
insights.locator: How is your company’s work addressing this growth?

insights.claim: Perforce accelerated engagements in 2026 with four of the largest semiconductor companies in the world as AI began changing the industry.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: AI-driven design change is translating into tooling deals at top chipmakers.
insights.locator: What was the most exciting high point of 2026

insights.claim: Perforce IPLM is designed to sit above existing data management, EDA tools and verification systems (P4, Git or otherwise), avoiding rip-and-replace migrations.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Overlay positioning lowers adoption friction versus incumbent EDA data stacks.
insights.locator: How is your company’s work addressing this challenge?

insights.claim: Customer engagements typically start when a team realizes it cannot find or trust its own IP—often during a vendor, partner or acquisition intake—then proceed through technical evaluation and proof of concept to production, expanding team by team.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Land-and-expand sales motion; M&A integration is a trigger event.
insights.locator: How do customers normally engage with your company?

insights.claim: Moondhra predicts the biggest 2027 growth area is IP reuse treated as a real workflow strategy, as budgets tighten while design complexity climbs.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Chip-design budgets shifting toward productivity tooling over headcount.
insights.locator: What do you think the biggest growth area for 2027 will be

insights.claim: Moondhra argues the fastest-growing chip companies in 2027 will be those that stopped paying for the same engineering work many times over, not those with the most engineers, and those whose systems handle AI and agentic data scale.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Engineering productivity, not headcount, as a competitive metric for chip designers.
insights.quote: The companies that grow fastest in 2027 won’t be the ones with the most engineers
